mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before consulting a contractor about expanding my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before booking an initial consultation, gather a copy of your property survey or plot plan, identify your target budget, and make a list of your functional priorities. Knowing where your property lines, utility easements, and setback boundaries sit helps determine how far outward your home can expand. It is also helpful to clarify how you intend to use the room—such as a primary bedroom suite, family entertainment room, or home office—so our team can evaluate whether your existing electrical panel and plumbing lines can support the expansion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Locate your property survey, define your intended use for the new space, establish a realistic budget range, and identify your priority features before your design meeting.
